shared_elements: repeated small strokes/crescents in a row
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces use flat, schematic silhouette/outline figures and repeated rows of small strokes (crew-lines in A, the ring of crescent-like marks and wave bands in B), which is a generic convention rather than a shared motif. A depicts a scattered, unframed accumulation of manned boats with no bordering scheme, while B is a framed panel centred on a large multi-armed whirl disc flanked by profile quadrupeds between horizontal ornamental bands — no boats, no whirl, no shared composition.
